messages:
Sam H: Quick handoff — I'm clocking out at 18:00 PT. Maria, you're on for the overnight window (19:00 PT -> 07:00 PT). A few operational notes and temporary routing tweaks below.

oncall-bot: Rotation update applied: Maria L assigned 2026-03-20 19:00 -> 2026-03-21 07:00. Applied route 'batch-alerts' -> #eng-oncall-low for 19:00-23:00.

Sam H: Nightly job is daily-embed-refresh (k8s cron). Historically spikes at start-of-window; to reduce noise we routed batch-related alerts to #eng-oncall-low for the first 4 hours.

Sam H: Also temporarily raising the inference-latency alert threshold for g2x pool from 450ms -> 600ms for the same window to avoid flapping during rollout. We'll revert at 23:00 unless we see a real SLO violation.

Sam H: Route snippet I applied in Alertmanager (FYI):
```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'team-pager'
  routes:
    - match:
        alertname: 'BatchJobSpike'
      receiver: 'eng-oncall-low'
      continue: false
```

Maria L: Thanks — acknowledged. I'll monitor queue depth, CPU, and tail latencies. If latency stays > 650ms for 10m after 22:30 PT I'll flip route back and escalate.

Akshay P: Heads-up: there's a little config drift between staging/prod alertmanagers that causes the kv-cache-miss alert to fire too eagerly. I'll open a small PR to bump the 'kv-cache-miss' rate threshold for batch windows (150 -> 180 /min) and add a label match for cronjob=daily-embed-refresh.

Akshay P: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-configs/pull/412 (will tag reviewers)

Jen K: Pinged infra to check that the PagerDuty escalation won't override the routing change. Infra says PD escalation honors channel routing but manual overrides are possible if needed.

InfraOps: Confirmed — PD escalation respects the Alertmanager -> Slack route. If you need us to temporarily mute PD for the route, DM and we can apply a suppression.

Sam H: One more operational note: if embed queue > 5000, reduce emboss-worker concurrency to 4 to slow ingestion:
`kubectl scale --replicas=4 deploy/emboss-worker -n prod`

Maria L: Copy that. I'll post a short status update at ~21:00 PT and another before 23:00 PT. If I need help with PD or suppression I'll @InfraOps.

Jen K: I'll add a two-line runbook to the oncall doc for clearing stuck workers (kubectl delete pod ... + restart job).

Sam H: Thanks — appreciate it. Leaving notes in the handoff doc too. :thumbsup:

Maria L: Got it. Onwatching.
